record_types.description: Governance intelligence: circumvention reports, risk telemetry, emerging threat patterns
Governance posture statements: compliance status, audit results, governance configuration
Node capability declarations: supported governance functions and signal types
Structured incident reports: governance breaches, near-misses, and applied mitigations
Policy updates and governance rule changes published for peer node evaluation

trust_model.description: Two-tier trust: federation publisher trust (GFN-1) + agent runtime trust (RFC-0004)

factors.name: Historical Accuracy (H)
factors.description: Fraction of signals not contradicted over 90-day window

factors.name: Consistency and Quality (Q)
factors.description: Schema compliance, confidence calibration, update timeliness

factors.name: Federation Reputation (F)
factors.description: Peer assessment from other federation nodes

agent_runtime_trust.non_override_constraint: No reputation score can override a threat detection block under any condition
